Third-party code, pinned and self-hosted (no CDN at runtime).

To upgrade: download the new versions from the npm registry, check the integrity, replace these folders and update the paths in index.php.
Roboto (SIL Open Font License 1.1) - https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Roboto - latin subset, variable weight, from Google Fonts (v51): vendor/roboto/roboto-latin.woff2
Gelasio (SIL Open Font License 1.1) - https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Gelasio - metric-compatible with Georgia, used where Georgia isn't installed (Android): vendor/gelasio/gelasio-latin.woff2
